name: Rekindle
summary: An extinguished fire pit holds dry wood ready to catch flame. You put your scout skills to work.

sections.title: By the Fire Pit
sections.body: The wood is dry enough to take a flame. You put your scout skills to work beside the extinguished fire pit.

faq.answer: An extinguished fire pit has dry wood ready to catch flame, and you put your scout skills to work.

faq.q: What is wrong with the fire pit?
faq.answer: The fire pit is extinguished, though its wood is dry enough to catch flame.
The completion says you put your scout skills to work.
